posting.title: Software Engineer, New Grad (Backend)
posting.description_text:
Ledgerline Payments builds payment infrastructure for small businesses (fintech).
About the role: join our backend team as a new-grad software engineer.
You have: a BS in Computer Science (2025 or 2026 graduates); internship experience building REST APIs.
Our stack: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Docker and AWS.
You will build microservices that move money reliably.
